entities.description: A stylized, parchment-like map of the Iberian Peninsula, featuring a textured beige landmass with faint internal borders and a surrounding teal-blue sea. The map has an aged, weathered appearance with irregular edges and a few small islands visible off the southeastern coast.

A detailed, vintage-style map of Europe and surrounding regions, featuring a parchment-like texture with muted earth tones and teal-colored water bodies. The landmasses are depicted with intricate coastlines, mountain ranges, and political boundaries, all rendered in a sepia-toned palette that evokes an antique cartographic aesthetic.

The landmass is depicted with rough, hand-drawn black outlines and small, stylized tree symbols along the coastline, while the surrounding water is a muted teal color with subtle aging effects.

A stylized, hand-drawn map of the island of Ireland, depicted in a parchment-like beige color with a rough, irregular coastline. The landmass is set against a muted, textured teal or light blue background representing the sea, with a slightly aged or vintage aesthetic.

A small, irregularly shaped island with a sandy beige landmass and a rugged coastline, surrounded by a light blue-green sea. The island features sparse vegetation, with a few small trees or shrubs scattered across its surface, and a slightly elevated area towards the center.

A stylized, vintage-style map of the Anatolian peninsula (modern-day Turkey), rendered in sepia and beige tones with a textured, parchment-like appearance. The landmass is surrounded by teal-colored water, with visible coastlines and adjacent land fragments to the west and south.
